1.title: The Outskirts
lines: Lumen City went dark one night.
In a scrapyard on the edge of town, one small spark wakes up. Its name is Pip.
Pip's charge lasts 25 moves. When it runs out, Pip rewinds, and its old run stays behind as an echo.

2.title: The Market
lines: The Market used to glow all night.
Its doors need many hands. Luckily, Pip has echoes.
Every echo keeps working, exactly as you taught it.

3.title: The Core
lines: The Core powers the whole city.
Its locks open only to perfect timing.
Four echoes, one Pip, one chance to bring the light back.

4.title: The Power Lines
lines: The Core is awake, but its power can't reach the city.
The Power Lines are broken: wild lasers, crumbling floors.
Watch the rhythm, step lightly, and let your echoes lead the way.
The Core hums. One by one, the windows wake.
Lumen City glows again, lit by a small spark and everything it left behind.
